primary_title: Structural basis for a direct interaction between FGFR1 and NCAM and evidence for a regulatory role of ATP
decision_basis: NCAM F3 modules directly interact with FGFR1 Ig modules by SPR/NMR, induce FGFR phosphorylation and stimulate neurite outgrowth
limitations_preserved: Promote the direct NCAM-FGFR1 extracellular interaction and receptor activation only in the tested domain/neuronal context; preserve ATP inhibition and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Nectin-1 binds and signals through the fibroblast growth factor receptor
decision_basis: Nectin-1 Ig3 binds FGFR isoforms by SPR, induces FGFR1c phosphorylation and supports neurite outgrowth and neuronal survival
limitations_preserved: Promote direct Nectin-1-FGFR1 binding/activation at the soluble Ig3 and FGFR1c neuronal-development layer; do not generalize across nectins/FGFRs or infer SCI/terminal-TF effects.

decision_basis: N-cadherin and FGFR1 cocluster after expression, and soluble N-cadherin-Fc elicits FGFR-dependent cerebellar neurite outgrowth
limitations_preserved: Use association/cross-talk rather than an unqualified purified binary-binding claim; preserve cerebellar neuronal context and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Structural basis for parathyroid hormone-related protein binding to the parathyroid hormone receptor and design of conformation-selective peptides
decision_basis: PTHrP N-terminal peptide binds the PTH1R extracellular domain in a solved structure with interface-specific hybrid-peptide consequences
limitations_preserved: Promote direct mature N-terminal PTHrP-ECD binding only; the cited structure does not by itself establish full-length G-protein signaling, so preserve peptide-form and binding-only boundaries.

primary_title: Receptor-mediated endocytosis of transferrin in K562 cells
decision_basis: Diferric transferrin binds TfR1 on K562 cells, is rapidly internalized and recycled, and delivers iron intracellularly
limitations_preserved: Preserve holo/diferric transferrin, TfR1 homodimer and pH-dependent recycling; transport/endocytosis only, with no kinase relay or CNS inference.

primary_title: The transferrin receptor is a mediator of H-ferritin uptake
decision_basis: Expression cloning identifies TfR1 as an H-ferritin receptor, with soluble-receptor precipitation, cell binding and endosomal/lysosomal uptake
limitations_preserved: Restrict the edge to H-ferritin/FTH-containing ferritin rather than L-ferritin; preserve cargo-receptor uptake semantics and no canonical signaling or CNS claim.

primary_title: Transferrin receptor 2 mediates uptake of transferrin-bound iron
decision_basis: TFR2-transfected CHO cells bind and internalize transferrin-bound iron with competition, siRNA and recycling evidence
limitations_preserved: Preserve the lower-affinity TFR2 transport branch and distinguish it from dominant TfR1; no kinase relay or CNS inference.

primary_title: HFE, the protein defective in hereditary hemochromatosis, is a ligand for transferrin receptor
decision_basis: Soluble HFE and TfR assays support an HFE-beta2M/TfR homodimer complex that competes with diferric transferrin at overlapping receptor sites
limitations_preserved: Represent HFE as a beta2M-dependent regulatory MHC-I-like partner/competitor, not a canonical ligand; preserve ternary-complex semantics and no CNS inference.

primary_title: RPTPalpha is essential for NCAM-mediated p59fyn activation and neurite elongation
decision_basis: NCAM140 associates with RPTPalpha, enabling p59fyn activation and NCAM-dependent neurite elongation in neuronal systems
limitations_preserved: Preserve the NCAM140 isoform and RPTPalpha-to-Fyn functional coupling; association/neurite layer only, with no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: NCAM140 interacts with the focal adhesion kinase p125(fak) and the SRC-related tyrosine kinase p59(fyn)
decision_basis: NCAM140 interacts with p59fyn and p125FAK in neuronal and heterologous systems, supporting an isoform-specific receptor-proximal association
limitations_preserved: Promote the NCAM140 isoform-specific Fyn association only; preserve co-IP/neuronal context and do not infer a direct extracellular ligand edge, SCI effect or terminal TF.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4810158, L1CAM trafficking and cytoskeletal review
primary_title: Cytoplasmic domain mutations of the L1 cell adhesion molecule reduce L1-ankyrin interactions
decision_basis: L1 cytoplasmic-domain mutations reduce ankyrin interactions and alter ankyrin recruitment in neuronal and heterologous cells
limitations_preserved: Preserve the L1CAM cytoplasmic motif and ankyrin-B/ANK2 coupling; cytoskeletal/neuritogenesis layer only, with no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: The Neural Cell Adhesion Molecule L1 Interacts with the AP-2 Adaptor and Is Endocytosed via the Clathrin-Mediated Pathway
decision_basis: The L1 cytoplasmic YRSLE motif binds AP-2 and supports clathrin-mediated endocytosis
limitations_preserved: Promote motif-mediated AP-2/AP2M1 trafficking only; preserve unphosphorylated motif/endocytosis semantics and do not infer productive signaling or SCI/terminal-TF effects.
